context: Two teens reminisce about junior-high school days
purpose: Teach: 中学校/僕ら/全身/歌い/おしゃべり/笑う/班/ライバル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、中学校の頃ってさ、私たちめっちゃバカやってたよね。
lines.en: Hey, back in junior high, we really did some stupid stuff, didn't we?
lines.style: Casual nostalgic teen girl, warm and giggly tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あー、わかる。僕らさ、体育祭の応援練習で全身筋肉痛になったの覚えてる?
lines.en: Oh yeah, totally. Remember how we got sore all over from sports festival cheer practice?
lines.style: Relaxed teen boy, slightly nasal, easy-going laugh

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 覚えてる覚えてる!みんなで歌い踊って、休み時間もずっとおしゃべりしてさ。
lines.en: I remember, I remember! We were all singing and dancing, and chatting nonstop during breaks too.
lines.style: Bubbly teen girl, fast-paced excited delivery

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 先生に注意されても、目が合うと思わず笑うんだよなあ。
lines.en: Even when the teacher scolded us, we'd just burst out laughing the second our eyes met.
lines.style: Wistful teen boy, soft chuckle in his voice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あとさ、給食の班、いつも一緒だったよね。リクって本当に食べるの早くて。
lines.en: And remember, we were always in the same lunch group. Riku, you ate way too fast.
lines.style: Teasing teen girl, playful and warm tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いやいや、サクラがライバルだったから必死だったの。負けたくなくて。
lines.en: No no, you were my rival, so I was dead serious. I didn't wanna lose.
lines.style: Mock-defensive teen boy, grinning through the words

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なにそれ、子供すぎ(笑)。でもああいう時間って、もう戻ってこないんだなって思うとちょっと寂しい。
lines.en: What was that, so childish, ha. But thinking those days won't come back makes me a little sad.
lines.style: Soft teen girl, laughing then turning gently melancholic

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん…でもこうやって思い出話できるの、結構いいよな。
lines.en: Yeah... but being able to look back together like this is actually pretty nice, isn't it?
lines.style: Gentle teen boy, sincere and slightly shy delivery
